notes: All financial statement amounts are original full CNY units; no aggregation, estimation or interpolation. Accounting standard is the PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, first adopted2007; earlier comparative reclassifications do not change the year dates.

revenue is Operating revenue(营业收入) from the issuer three-year key-data table. It excludes separately reported interest and other income of the finance subsidiary; providers using total operating income may differ. operatingIncome is the consolidated PRC operating profit line, not an adjusted EBITDA measure.

netIncome is attributable to listed-company shareholders. totalEquity uses the explicitly published parent-equity aggregate; ambiguous early total-equity summary rows are not substituted.2021 and2022 use the2023 report explicitly restated deferred-tax comparatives under Accounting Standards Interpretation16.

capex is the company-published combined purchase of fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets, stored negative. Cash and equivalents is from the consolidated cash-flow statement, not the broader monetary-funds balance. Finance subsidiary deposit flows can materially affect operating cash flow.

Dividends, total debt, shares outstanding and employees are null where compatible direct annual values were not extracted; no issued-minus-treasury calculation, debt component sum or inferred zero is used. EPS retains the published split/bonus-share basis of the cited report rather than applying an unsourced adjustment.
